records.reported_operational_impact: The Star reported a group net loss of RM55.3 million for the year ended 31 July 2026, versus a RM33 million profit in the preceding year; the loss included a RM39.7 million non-cash impairment. The report attributed lower Malaysia-segment sales in part to reduced orders.

The company name appears in the supplied search scope, but no graph entity, current supplier relationship, specific customer's order or affected shipment has been verified.
